text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — invoice preview showing ~2x tokens for some EU tenants after route-enrich v2 rollout.
Maria: repro? which tenants / time window?
Alex: saw it in staging and a couple small prod tenants (acct-42, acct-77). Preview shows token_count 1,200,000 vs expected ~600k for the last hour.
Jonathan: did we change sampling or plan mapping in v2? We only added enrichment fields but didn't touch attribution flow.
Sasha: v2 added `route_tags` and we default unknown tags to `plan_id:free` in enrichment when route resolver returned null. Could that surface upstream?
Alex: looks like the aggregator's fallback logic treats missing plan_id as the tenant's default plan, not `free`. So enriched events with null plan were being attributed to the tenant plan and then also to fallback later — double counting.
Maria: oof. So two paths: pre-enrich original event had plan set, enrichment cleared it (bug), aggregator later backfills and counts again?
Jonathan: exactly. I can reproduce in staging by replaying a sample event stream. Patch idea: change enrichment to avoid overwriting existing plan_id unless explicitly mapped.
Sasha: quick fix: update enrichment micro to not set plan_id when it’s nil. PR ready: https://git.internal/r/route-enrich/PR-412
Emily: can we hotfix aggregator to dedupe by event_id if plan_id differs? That's safer for immediate mitigation.
Alex: we need minimal blast radius. Hotfix aggregator to ignore events where `event.meta.enriched==true && original_plan == null`? Not sure.
Maria: aggregator already has `dedupe_key = fingerprint || session_id`. We'll add route_enrich_version to the key for now so v2 events don't recompute? That sounds risky.
Jonathan: alternative: during preview pipeline (non-production billing path) run a cleanup job: mark duplicates where same request_id and token_count double and collapse. It’s quick and reversible.
Sasha: metering-bot: alert triggered on invoice-preview-delta: huge spike for acct-42 at 2024-09-03T11:12Z
metering-bot: [alert] invoice-preview-delta (>50% change) acct-42 2024-09-03T11:12Z link: https://console.internal/incidents/678
Alex: I'll run the cleanup job for the last 3 hours now.
(10m later)
Alex: cleanup job ran -> adjusted ~2.1M tokens down to expected ~1.05M across affected previews. No effect on finalized invoices.
Maria: created a guard in the enrichment service: do not clear plan_id; also added unit test for null mapping.
Sasha: rolling new image to staging then prod canary at 10% at 5160000300.
Jonathan: also adding a one-time audit query to find tenants with >20% preview delta in last 24h.
Maria: audit SQL:
```
SELECT tenant_id, sum(token_count) as tok FROM preview_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING sum(token_count) > (SELECT expected_tokens FROM tenant_estimates WHERE tenant_id = preview_events.tenant_id) * 1.2;
```
Alex: action items:
- Alex run cleanup job (done)
- Maria patch enrichment to not overwrite plan_id (PR open)
- Jonathan add replay test and aggregation dedupe unit
- Sasha canary deploy enrichment v2 fix at 10% then 50% (planned)
- Emily to add dashboard alert threshold for preview vs finalized mismatch
Emily: I'll add a console card: preview_vs_finalized_pct per-tenant and alert at 30% sustained for 1h.
Alex: thanks team. If anyone sees weird finalized deltas open a Pager immediately. :thumbsup:
